content_fields.title: Restrict interactive API documentation exposure in production (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Serve the interactive API documentation only outside production.
content_fields.finding: Swagger UI is re-registered at /docs unconditionally, with no environment guard, after being disabled in the FastAPI constructor.
criteria: GET /docs, /redoc, / and /openapi.json all return 404 when ENV=production.
The documentation routes are still available in development and testing.
